name: 19083 · Havertown, PA
findings: ZIP 19083 (Havertown) has 122 nonprofit organizations. 67 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 56 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19083 (Havertown) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
